### ✨ Solo Leveling: ARISE Mod Menu (v1.5.26)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu for **Solo Leveling: ARISE** by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Enable Damage Multiplier** — Scales Hunter & Shadow Attack and outgoing hit damage against enemies
- **Damage Multiplier (1x - 200x)** — Multiplier factor applied to outgoing player & ally attacks
- **Enable Defense Multiplier** — Boosts Player/Ally Defense & divides incoming HP damage
- **Defense Multiplier (1x - 200x)** — Defense & incoming damage reduction factor
- **Auto Hunter & Shadow Ally Detection** — Protects Sung Jinwoo, Hunters & Shadow allies while scaling enemy hits
- **Check Active Hooks & Player Link** — Displays UnityFramework hook mode & live combat calls

### 🛡️ Protection
- **1-User License**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
